tools.name: discover_facilities_for_hotel
tools.description: Scrapes a hotel website to discover which facilities from a provided list are offered. Checks page text, meta descriptions, and image alt tags.

website_url.description: The URL of the hotel website to scrape.

facilities.description: List of canonical facility names to search for.

existing_facilities.description: Optional: List of facility names already linked to the hotel.

hotel_name.description: Optional: Name of the hotel for debugging and evidence.
